plan.name: Attribute runtime tests and assertions
plan.summary: Add AttributeComponentRuntime and independent runtime JSON records alongside proof, conformance and assumptions, retaining exact selected tests and invocations, runner pins, all supplied declaration and execution-input snapshots, optional model and bounds context, and actual per-test and per-assertion exercised outcomes and diagnostics. Qualify each supplied test and assertion from its own outcome and required provenance, preserving unsuccessful or incomplete attempts without inventing evidence from process success, configuration or legacy results, and without claiming target code coverage, proof, exhaustive conformance, every-step coverage or validated assumptions. Make all four attribution APIs replace or clear only their own kind through detached validation of incoming and retained evidence, reject stale selections, targets, contracts, tests, outside-scope drivers, assumptions, invocations and referenced inputs atomically, and own and canonically fingerprint every nested value including after JSON decoding while preserving meaningful sequence order. Preserve complete production proof rows, earlier proof callers and extra known declarations, gate outcomes, ratified data, legacy checks, fingerprints, JSON, Markdown and literal escaping; run no tools and add no discovery, instrumentation, execution protocol, adapter or gate connection, keeping explicit code verification refused and model-only checking available. Update SPEC.md, README.md and Report documentation for all four APIs, JSON, runtime success, replacement/staleness, fingerprints and execution limits, keep Markdown as component proof coverage with the explicit declared-assumptions footer, cite the supporting decisions including D-0169 and D-0170 on changed SPEC bullets, and require the merger to record the new runtime attribution policy because plumbing builds cannot write decisions/; do not edit ratified statements or locks.

tests.name: TestRuntimeOutcomesDoNotInventTestsOrAssertions
tests.says: Process, test and assertion outcomes stay independent across passing, failed, timed-out, skipped, empty, missing and unexercised cases; no selection or legacy pass creates a missing test or assertion, and a passing actual test needs no assertions.

tests.name: TestRuntimeSuccessRequiresRunnerAndActualInputSnapshots
tests.says: Missing runner identity, target/contract/test declarations, execution files or applicable model/bounds provenance leave runtime evidence unchecked; an assertion additionally needs its own matching actual source, including additional supplied files.

tests.name: TestRuntimeKeepsDistinctSelectedChecksInvocationsAndActualAssertions
tests.says: Distinct selected tests and repeated invocations retain their actual outcomes, passing assertions survive enclosing failures, failed and unexercised assertions never inherit success, and configured but unreported tests remain absent.

tests.name: TestAllFourComponentKindsCoexistAndRoundTripWithoutTransferringProof
tests.says: A target holds all four kinds while a conformance-only neighbor, assumed-only neighbor and verified proof-contract helper remain unproved; complete inventory, legacy checks, gate outcomes and ratified data survive JSON round trips, and stale assurance labels cannot imply aggregate proof.

tests.name: TestRuntimeUpdatesPreserveConformanceObservationAndAttemptQualifications
tests.says: Runtime replacement and clearing retain sampled and bounded-exhaustive observations and absent, unsuccessful, incomplete and successful attempt coverage without erasing successful transitions or inflating exhaustive/every-step claims.

tests.name: TestSuppliedRuntimeRejectsInvalidAttributionAtomically
tests.says: Unknown, bare, unselected, duplicate and stale target/check/test/assertion/input references, invocation mismatches and optional model/bounds mismatches reject the whole batch, including invalid nested records after valid results, preserving report JSON bytes and stored and recomputed fingerprints.

tests.name: TestSuppliedRuntimeRejectsInvalidReplacementInventories
tests.says: Runtime replacement and clearing reject missing, non-explicit, duplicate or inconsistent inventories, provenance, selections and invocation inputs without changing any stored evidence.

tests.name: TestSuppliedRuntimeAcceptsKnownExtraInputsAndLocalAssertionIdentities
tests.says: Additional known declaration and file snapshots remain valid actual inputs, and opaque assertion identities are unique within their selected test rather than across unrelated tests.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeFourKindReplacementAndClear
tests.says: All 24 attribution orders under both gate outcomes independently update and clear each kind, accept canonically reordered inventories, preserve other evidence, legacy checks and ratified data, and produce equivalent finalized reports and fingerprints.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeRetainedByEveryOtherUpdateAndClear
tests.says: Proof, conformance and assumption updates or clears reject complete and incomplete retained runtime after target, contract, test, selection, invocation, actual input, model/include/lock or applicable bounds changes, with independently valid incoming evidence and byte-for-byte rollback.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeUpdatesRevalidateEveryRetainedKind
tests.says: Runtime updates and clears reject stale retained proofs, conformance and assumptions, including incomplete attempts, after target/contract, test/input, invocation, assumption content/source and model/bounds changes without silently discarding or changing their claims.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeAndProofUpdatesRejectOutsideScopeConformanceEdit
tests.says: An edit confined to an outside-scope driver invalidates retained complete or incomplete conformance under both proof and runtime updates and clears even though production inventory is unchanged.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeKeepsLegacyProofExtraDeclarations
tests.says: Before or after runtime attribution, proof-only callers without invocation metadata retain valid extra verified declarations, checked contracts and input snapshots; incomplete proofs stay unchecked and no proof transfers to those declarations.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeFingerprintBindsEverySuppliedField
tests.says: Attribution and decoded-report fingerprints bind runtime presence, qualifications, each test/assertion identity, exercise and outcome, source, diagnostics, runner pins, invocations, declaration/file inputs and optional model/bounds context without mutating reports.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeCanonicalSetsSequencesAndRelocation
tests.says: All-four-kind storage and decoded fingerprints ignore set/completion order and checkout relocation, retain meaningful argument, observation and diagnostic order, and preserve existing volatile exclusions and component assurance.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeOwnsTypedArgumentsInventoryAndRetainedKinds
tests.says: Mutating concrete typed arguments to every public API, nested runtime tests/assertions, inputs, maps, pins or inventories cannot change stored evidence; replacement and clearing also detach all retained kinds from the prior report.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeAttributionNeverExecutesAndModelOnlyRejectsIt
tests.says: Sentinels confirm attribution and clearing run nothing and Check/Run return ErrComponents before tools start, while model-only checking stays available and model-only reports reject runtime attribution and clearing atomically.

tests.name: TestComponentRuntimeMarkdownRemainsAProofViewAndLegacyCompatible
tests.says: Runtime test/assertion details stay in JSON while Markdown keeps component proof coverage and its declared-assumptions footer; legacy JSON, fingerprints, successful receipt language and tool-output-only footer remain unchanged.
